_comment: The approved narrator roster. This file, not how many hours a reader has,
decides who ends up in the model.
The source corpus is a set of Australian TITLES read by international
LibriVox volunteers, so an Australian book is no guarantee of an Australian
narrator. Accent has to be checked by ear: run prepare/2-export.py
--audition and listen before adding anyone. The largest reader in this
corpus (11.79 h) was rejected at that gate after being the obvious pick on
reader  the exact name in the dataset's reader column. prepare/1-census.py
lists them with hours, clip counts and transcript quality.
sex     drives the female-only projection and the deploy tables.
Speaker labels are the reader name slugged, so 'Lucy Burgoyne (1950-2014)'
becomes lucy_burgoyne_1950_2014. Speaker IDS are assigned by piper during
training and written to the trained config -- read them from there
(deploy/2-voice-map.py), never from the order of this file.
